verses.1:
Not to us, O LORD, not to us,
 but to Your name be the glory,
 because of Your loving devotion,
 because of Your faithfulness.
verses.2:
Why should the nations say,
 “Where is their God?”
verses.3:
Our God is in heaven;
 He does as He pleases.
verses.4:
Their idols are silver and gold,
 made by the hands of men.
verses.5:
They have mouths, but cannot speak;
 they have eyes, but cannot see;
verses.6:
they have ears, but cannot hear;
 they have noses, but cannot smell;
verses.8:
Those who make them become like them,
 as do all who trust in them.
verses.9:
O Israel, + 115:9 MT; many Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Syriac O house of Israel trust in the LORD!
 He is their help and shield.
verses.10:
O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD!
 He is their help and shield.
verses.11:
You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD!
 He is their help and shield.
verses.13:
He will bless those who fear the LORD—
 small and great alike.
verses.14:
May the LORD give you increase,
 both you and your children.
verses.15:
May you be blessed by the LORD,
 the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.16:
The highest heavens belong to the LORD,
 but the earth He has given to mankind.
verses.17:
It is not the dead who praise the LORD,
 nor any who descend into silence.
verses.18:
But it is we who will bless the LORD,
 both now and forevermore.
 Hallelujah! + 115:18 Or Hallelu YAH , meaning Praise the LORD

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
